metadata.scope: Build a NEW admin tag master (tag_definitions) catalog management screen in apps/web at route /admin/tags/catalog, and wire the 3 tag lifecycle operations onto it by consuming ONLY existing apps/api endpoints (no API change, no D1 schema change): (1) reactivate via POST /admin/tags/:tagId/reactivate (200 row, idempotent no-op when already active) shown on inactive rows; (2) logical delete via DELETE /admin/tags/:tagId (204, active=1->0, issue-1035 landed) shown on active rows; (3) physical delete via DELETE /admin/tags/:tagId/physical (204 on success / 409 tag_has_references + referenceCount when member_tags references exist / 404 tag_not_found) gated by an irreversible ConfirmDialog. The 3 lifecycle operations MUST be visually and textually distinct so an admin cannot confuse 'shelve back', 'shelve away', and 'destroy forever'. The 409 referenceCount is surfaced as 'N人に使用中のため削除不可'. New files: app/(admin)/admin/tags/catalog/page.tsx (Server Component, safeServerFetch GET /admin/tags), src/components/admin/TagCatalogPanel.tsx (client list + filter + lifecycle state machine), src/components/admin/TagCatalogRow.tsx (per-row 3 lifecycle controls), src/components/admin/tagCatalogLifecycle.ts (pure helpers: operation descriptors, 409 body parse, active/inactive status label). Edits: src/styles/globals.css (.admin-tag-catalog-* classes, OKLch tokens only), admin sidebar nav link to /admin/tags/catalog. Reuse AdminPageHeader, AdminSectionErrorClient, safeServerFetch, useAdminMutation (DELETE=idempotent overload / POST=non-idempotent overload), ConfirmDialog (isDestructive), design tokens. This whole UI is completable in one implementation cycle. Issue #1118 stays CLOSED.

metadata.issue_optimization_note: Issue #1118 (= task-issue-1070-followup-002) was written assuming an EXISTING admin tag master UI (tag list / tag row / logical-delete control) into which lifecycle controls would be 'added'. Investigation of CURRENT code (2026-06-06) shows that premise is STALE: (1) reactivate / physical / referenceCount appear NOWHERE in apps/web (rg = 0 hits) — the issue is unresolved, not fixed by another task. (2) The supposed 'existing admin tag UI' does NOT exist: /admin/tags route is TagQueuePanel (member-tag assignment QUEUE), not a tag_definitions master screen; tag_definitions only surface inside member-drawer / bulk-action pickers. (3) The supposed 'logical-delete control landed in #1035' does NOT exist in apps/web — #1035 landed the API only; apps/web calls DELETE /admin/tags/:tagId from NOWHERE. (4) #1068 MemberTagInlineCreate is an in-drawer master-create, not a master management screen. Therefore the ROOT problem is broader than 'add a button': there is NO tag-master catalog screen to host lifecycle controls. Per user decision (2026-06-06 AskUserQuestion: 'build a dedicated screen'), this spec is optimized to BUILD a new /admin/tags/catalog screen first, then wire all 3 lifecycle operations onto it. The hosting API (GET /admin/tags with q/page/pageSize -> {total, items:[{tagId,code,label,category,active}]}) and the 3 mutation endpoints already exist and are unchanged. Reframed acceptance criteria add AC-0 (catalog screen exists and lists tag_definitions) and keep the original AC-1..AC-8 lifecycle/visual-distinction criteria, now hosted on the new screen.
